_doc: Dystopia Elasticsearch administrator role. Full management in the deception-* namespace (indices, templates, ILM, ingest pipelines) and Kibana, WITHOUT superuser privileges. Pre-loaded users (elastic built-in) remain reserved for bootstrapping; the day-to-day administrator operates with THIS role. It does not grant manage_security to maintain separation between function and control plane: only an emergency operator, never automated, uses 'elastic'.

indices._doc_2: allow_restricted_indices:true SOLO para gestionar saved objects de Kibana (.kibana es índice restringido). NO cubre .kibana_system ni otros índices restringidos.

dystopia.note: Sin manage_security: la gestión de usuarios/roles queda en el superusuario interno (elastic), usado solo en bootstrap y emergencias.
